title: The Fountains at Hidden Lake
address:
10456 W. Ashburn Lane
Crystal River, Florida 34428
United States
description:
The Fountains at Hidden Lake is a $24.5 million affordable housing community for residents 62 and older in Crystal River, Citrus County. The four-story building holds 81 units across more than 81,000 square feet, spread over a site of better than 7 acres.

On-site amenities include a resort-style pool, a fitness center, a dog park, a horseshoe court, a multipurpose community room, and a business center, backed by services such as wellness check-ins, light housekeeping, help with groceries and laundry, and a regular calendar of community events.
